title: APRIL 27. Old father, old artificer, stand me now and ever in good stead
html_source: Stephen’s aim is to be an artist for the rest of his life. “The uncreated conscience of my race” implies that he strives to be an artist who uses his individual voice to create a voice and conscience for the community where he was born and raised. The final entry, where it states “old father” and “old artifices” reinforces Stephen’s dual mission. “Old father” which can be read as either Simon or Ireland itself in order to acknowledge his debt to his past. “Old artificer” references Daedalus, the master craftsman from ancient Greek mythology, this emphasizes his role as an artist. It is through his art that Stephen will use his individuality to create a voice for his community.

anchor.text: APRIL 27. Old father, old artificer, stand me now and ever in good stead
anchor.prefix: s. Amen. So be it. Welcome, O life! I go to encounter for the millionth time the reality of experience and to forge in the smithy of my soul the uncreated conscience of my race.
